summary: Schema 3 lets you set ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_LIST, _AUTOMATION_HUB_URL and _AUTH_URL with ENV in prepend_galaxy, and receive the hub token with ARG ANSIBLE_GALAXY_SERVER_AUTOMATION_HUB_TOKEN passed by --build-arg, so it does not leak into the final image.
questions: How do I pass an automation hub token to ansible-builder without leaking it?
